93:t_2:45.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, yes! Then let's start with $$ノノ$$...」

93:t_2:47.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'm $$ニコラス・バセロン$$. Please call me $$ニコラ$$.」

93:t_2:48.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I'm $$カシオ・タカシロウ$$. Leave the maintenance of the $$バスターマシン$$s to me.」

93:t_2:49.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$チコ・サイエンス$$. Nice to meet you.」

93:t_2:50.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm $$ラルク・メルク・マール$$.」

93:t_2:51.en:
$$チコ$$
「Introduce yourself properly, $$姫$$. Tell them you're the ace with the number one kill score of all the $$トップレス$$.」

93:t_2:52.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Forget it, I don't want to talk about that.」

93:t_2:53.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Wow, Big Sis! I knew it, you really are the strongest and the greatest!」

93:t_2:54.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Enough of that. Hurry up and introduce yourself.」

93:t_2:55.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm $$ノノ$$! From today, we're in the care of $c!」

93:t_2:56.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Single and in full bloom! A dreaming maiden! I'm still just an apprentice in the $$フラタニティ$$, but I'll give it my all with effort and guts!」

93:t_2:60.en:
$n
「N-not at all! It's just that, compared to the other members, you're a little off...!」

93:t_2:61.en:
$n
「Ah... On the contrary, that's what made it fresh, so we were dumbfounded... I mean, surprised...」

93:t_2:62.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... You don't have to force yourself to cover for her...」

93:t_2:63.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll give you credit for the guts to try a role you're not used to, though...」

93:t_2:64.en:
$$チコ$$
「This girl is an android. So maybe that's why she's a little different from us.」

93:t_2:67.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Heh heh... I'm embarrassed to say so, but yes.」

93:t_2:70.en:
$$宗介$$
「Still, I understand how Ox feels.」

93:t_2:71.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Yeah. I can't bring myself to call her a tin can.」

93:t_2:72.en:
$$ノノ$$
「P-please don't stare so much. You're making me blush...」

93:t_2:73.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I don't know how it is here, but in our world androids are granted a fair share of rights too.」

93:t_2:74.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I won't allow anyone to lay a hand on her.」

93:t_2:76.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I just hate the stares of lecherous men.」

93:t_2:77.en:
$$チコ$$
「That's our $$姫$$. As an ace, you had men all over the world watching you.」

93:t_2:79.en:
$$アルト$$
「Doesn't look like they have much teamwork...」

93:t_2:80.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's not true! We're the $$フラタニティ$$, bound together by strong ties!」

93:t_2:81.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Though $$ノノ$$ is just an apprentice.」

93:t_2:83.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Now we're part of your team too. We look forward to working with you.」

93:t_2:84.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Question! Are the robots you all use also called $$バスターマシン$$s?」

93:t_2:86.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Someone we know also rides a robot that's called a $$バスターマシン$$.」

93:t_2:87.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Its name is $$ガンバスター$$! ...Ever heard of it?」

93:t_2:89.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That person was fighting $$宇宙怪獣$$ too, you know.」

93:t_2:90.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Could you tell me more about that? I've been wondering about the fact that enemies also called $$宇宙怪獣$$ exist.」

93:t_2:91.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then you should ask $$ノリコ$$.」

93:t_2:92.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノリリ$$!? Is $$ノノリリ$$ here!?」

93:t_2:94.en:
$$勝平$$
「What's this $$ノノリリ$$ you're talking about?」

93:t_2:95.en:
$$ノノ$$
「She's the astronaut $$ノノ$$ looks up to. She's so beautiful, so wonderful, so strong...」

93:t_2:96.en:
$$ノノ$$
「On top of that, I hear she had an amazing figure.」

93:t_2:97.en:
$n
「Oh, then she's a different person from the $$ノリコ$$ we know.」

93:t_2:99.en:
$n
「A-anyway...! Just try meeting $$ノリコ$$ once. Then you'll understand.」

93:t_2:101.en:
$$アルト$$
「Unfortunately, we don't know where she is either.」

93:t_2:102.en:
$$甲児$$
「But knowing her, she's sure to be fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ somewhere.」

93:t_2:103.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Understood. Looking forward to the day I meet $$ノリコ$$, $$ノノ$$ will do her best to keep on living!」

93:t_2:104.en:
$$ルカ$$
「However, considering the $$エキゾチックマニューバ$$, $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$ and your $$バスターマシン$$s were probably built with technology from a different lineage.」

93:t_2:105.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So it's a parallel world thing, and it has nothing to do with $$ノリコ$$ in particular...」

93:t_2:106.en:
$$正太郎$$
「'Gundam' exists in all sorts of worlds too. $$バスターマシン$$s and $$宇宙怪獣$$ must be the same.」

93:t_2:107.en:
$$宗介$$
「In other words, $$バアル$$ exists in every world...」

93:t_2:108.en:
$n
「But the power to fight them is gathering like this.」

93:t_2:109.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're right. Let's cherish this encounter.」

93:t_2:110.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We will soon link up with the forces of $$蒼の地球$$.」

93:t_2:111.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I hear they've succeeded in strengthening their forces as well.」

93:t_2:113.en:
$$テッサ$$
「As soon as we reach $$蒼の地球$$, we'll begin preparing to take the $$新地球皇国$$ capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

93:t_2:114.en:
$n
「The decisive battle with the $$サイデリアル$$...」

93:t_2:115.en:
$$ランド$$
「Heh... My arms are itching for it.」

93:t_2:116.en:
$n
「You just wait, $$サイデリアル$$... We will make you pay back what you owe... what you owe every last person on Earth.」

93:t_2:117.en:
$$ニコラ$$
($$蒼の地球$$... $$新地球皇国$$... $$サイデリアル$$...)

93:t_2:118.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(I'll do that part any way I please. But with this unit, I'll also get information on parallel-world $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$バスターマシン$$s...)

93:t_10:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$... I see. Now I understand why everyone was so surprised when they saw $$ノノ$$.」

93:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We're both lovable bodies all the same.」

93:t_10:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Though the direction is quite different.」

93:t_10:7.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「At least, I don't think anyone would go 'mecha girl, so moe~' over you.」
